<mxfile host="Electron" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) draw.io/28.2.5 Chrome/138.0.7204.251 Electron/37.6.1 Safari/537.36" version="28.2.5"> <diagram id="permission-sequence" name="权限验证时序图"> <mxGraphModel dx="-534" dy="-202" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="0" page="0" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1000" pageHeight="800" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="p1" value="HTTP 请求" style="shape=umlLifeline;perimeter=lifelinePerimeter;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="20" width="120" height="680" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2" value="SecureInterceptor" style="shape=umlLifeline;perimeter=lifelinePerimeter;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="210" y="20" width="140" height="680" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p3" value="JWT 解码" style="shape=umlLifeline;perimeter=lifelinePerimeter;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="410" y="20" width="120" height="680" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p4" value="BladePermissionHandler" style="shape=umlLifeline;perimeter=lifelinePerimeter;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="590" y="20" width="160" height="680" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p5" value="Redis / SysCache" style="shape=umlLifeline;perimeter=lifelinePerimeter;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="810" y="20" width="140" height="680" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m1" value="1. 请求到达
GET /blade-system/user/list" style="strokeColor=#333;strokeWidth=2" parent="1" source="p1" target="p2" edge="1"> <mxGeometry x="-10" relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="30" y="90" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="210" y="90" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m2" value="2. 是否跳过 URL?
/blade-auth/**, /doc.html..." style="strokeColor=#333;strokeWidth=1" parent="1" target="p2" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="280" y="140" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="280" y="180" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m2a" value="✅ 是 → 放行" style="text;html=1;fontSize=10;fontColor=#60a917" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="290" y="160" width="100" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m3" value="3. 提取 JWT Token
从 Header: Blade-Auth" style="strokeColor=#333;strokeWidth=2" parent="1" source="p2" target="p3" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="210" y="220" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="410" y="220" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m4" value="4. JWT 解码验证
解析 userId, tenantId, roleId" style="strokeColor=#333;strokeWidth=1" parent="1" target="p3" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="470" y="270" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="470" y="310" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m5" value="5. 返回 BladeUser" style="strokeColor=#333;strokeWidth=2;startArrow=classic" parent="1" source="p3" target="p2" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="410" y="350" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="280" y="350" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m6" value="6. hasPermission(code) 
或 hasMenu(code)" style="strokeColor=#333;strokeWidth=2" parent="1" source="p2" target="p4" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="280" y="400" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="590" y="400" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m7" value="7. 查询缓存
apiScope:code:{code}:{roleId}" style="strokeColor=#333;strokeWidth=2" parent="1" source="p4" target="p5" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="590" y="450" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="810" y="450" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m7a" value="缓存命中 → 返回" style="text;html=1;fontSize=10;fontColor=#60a917" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="640" y="475" width="130" height="20" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m8" value="8. 缓存未命中 → 查 DB
SELECT FROM blade_scope_data" style="strokeColor=#999;strokeWidth=1;dashed=1" parent="1" target="p4" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="670" y="510" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="670" y="550" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m9" value="9. 写入缓存
SYS_CACHE" style="strokeColor=#333;strokeWidth=2" parent="1" source="p4" target="p5" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="590" y="580" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="810" y="580" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m10" value="10. 权限验证结果
通过 / 拒绝" style="strokeColor=#333;strokeWidth=2;startArrow=classic" parent="1" source="p4" target="p2" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="590" y="630" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="350" y="630" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="m11" value="11. 放行 / 403" style="strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=3" parent="1" source="p2" target="p1" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <mxPoint x="210" y="670" as="sourcePoint" /> <mxPoint x="90" y="670" as="targetPoint" /> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> <mxCell id="src" value="代码来源: bladex-tool/.../secure/SecureInterceptor.java
bladex-boot/.../handler/BladePermissionHandler.java
bladex-boot/.../cache/SysCache.java" style="text;html=1;align=left;valign=top;fontSize=10;fontColor=#999" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="30" y="640" width="400" height="50" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="note1" value="⚠️ 权限缓存 Key:
SYS_CACHE:apiScope:code:{code}:{roleId}" style="shape=note;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=10" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="810" y="410" width="180" height="40" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
